description: General Hysteresis Model Data and MATLAB codes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Thang Dao, University of Alabama (ua.edu). This project publish the data and MATLAB codes generated for publication: A General Hysteresis Model for Applications in Structural Dynamics. The paper is published on ASCE Journal of Structural Engineering. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Hysteresis,  Structural dynamics, Wind, Hurricane, Tornadoes, Earthquake. Published 2025-06-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
